name: print-social-violet-event-ticketing-promo-with-tilted-cards
title: Violet Ticketing Promo with Tilted Event Cards
whatItIs: A saturated violet portrait promo with a big white headline, an overlapping tilted tag, body copy and three angled white photo cards for a conference, music festival and funfair, with a link pill at the foot.
whatItMeans: Loud color and playful tilts create an energetic, festival-like mood. The tilted cards imply variety and motion.
techniques: Fan of rotated cards to imply a range of options
Headline overlapped by a translucent label as a brand stamp
Full-bleed single-color ground with white type for high contrast
Photo top and text bottom card format repeated three times
Footer pill combining web and social handles

vocabulary.definition: Cards rotated at slight angles and overlapped like a hand of playing cards.
A small pill overlapping a headline to mark the brand.
A rounded strip holding contact details.
